fact: Algeria is listed among about 34 countries where Starlink is in regulatory limbo, neither approved nor explicitly banned, as of June 2026; no licence or sale is stated (date is the article's publication date).

ARPCE launched a call for competition on 9 April 2026 for two licences for public satellite networks in non-geostationary orbit (NGSO), so no NGSO/LEO provider such as Starlink was yet licensed in Algeria; Starlink's service date for Algeria is stated as unknown.

State-owned Algerie Telecom Satellite (VSAT and GMPCS licences) and Djezzy (VSAT licence, to connect isolated sites with connectivity services mainly for businesses) are the only companies authorised to provide satellite services in Algeria; no licence date is given, so the article date is used.
